summary: Frontend-only Phase 5 Accounting workspace testing. All primary flows PASS: Accounting user can access /accounting with 8 tabs (Dashboard, Invoice, Receivable, Expense, Refund, HPP, Tax, Reports); revenue KPI cards render; Expense add and Refund add persist and appear in respective lists; Tax Master seeded with 5 rows, add new tax and edit existing tax (rate + effective_from) persist; HPP table renders; Reports tab shows all export buttons (xlsx/csv/pdf) with correct data-testids. RBAC: Sales user is blocked from /accounting (403 Forbidden page shown) and has NO Accounting item in sidebar. Super Admin has 'Accounting Dashboard' menu, can open /accounting, sees all tabs including Tax with add/edit tax buttons.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing DialogDescription/aria-describedby - accessibility warning in console (non-blocking)
React duplicate key warning appears on SA dashboard render (non-blocking, not in accounting scope but observed)

action_items: Low priority: Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to ExpenseDialog/RefundDialog/TaxDialog to silence a11y warning.
Low priority: Investigate duplicate React key warning shown on Super Admin dashboard (unrelated to Accounting).
critical_code_review_comments: Accounting.jsx exports report URL with `?auth=${token}` query param - this passes the JWT via URL which can leak into browser history/server logs. Prefer downloading via authenticated fetch + blob or short-lived signed URLs.
Auth token pulled from localStorage directly instead of centralised api/auth module - inconsistent access pattern.
Tab visibility relies on hasPerm hooks but backend already enforces; good defense in depth.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 test expense (150000), 1 test refund (TEST_Customer_A, 50000), 1 test tax rate (TST####, 7% -> then first row rate updated to 12% effective 2026-02-01).
